relations: The middle-ground fog drifts toward the distant peaks, broadening to soften the lower mountainside and hide trees.
Wisps of cloud move along the left rocky flank, curling around ridges as the main fog mass shifts.
Sky clouds above the peaks slowly change shape and brightness, leaving patches of blue visible between them.
Foreground vegetation remains stationary while the advancing fog edge partly obscures the trees behind its boundary.
caption: The video captures a mountain valley where a steep rocky slope rises on the left and jagged sunlit peaks stand on the right beneath a blue sky touched with pink clouds. Green shrubs and small trees fill the foreground, while a broad bank of white fog drifts through the middle ground. The fog shifts and broadens across the valley toward the distant peaks, softening the lower mountainside and partly hiding the trees behind its edge. Wisps of cloud move along the rocky flank, curling around ridges as the main mass changes shape. Above the peaks, the sky clouds slowly change shape and brightness, leaving patches of blue visible between them. The scene remains open and unsettled, with the fog still moving through the valley and the mountainside still partly veiled.
